title: Ending a traffic stop from the radio
changes: Fixed: "Dispatch, show me off my 10-11" on the patrol radio set officers to 10-11 instead of 10-8. Leaving a status now puts you back to 10-8
With RPM CyberCom, clearing a traffic stop from the patrol radio closes it properly, and anyone still in the stop channel is asked if they want to be moved back
If you leave a traffic stop channel without clearing the stop, starting your next 10-11 closes the old one instead of saying you are already on one
